 Order
Order No. 30.03.2026
 07. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Pursuant to the query made by this Court vide order dated 6th November, 2025, Mr. Satapathy,
learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that the Collector has no power to entertain an application filed under Section 64(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (For brevity 'the Act') beyond the statutory period, as provided under Section 64(2) of the Act..
3.

sentences.text: He, however, prays for an adjournment to take instruction as to whether any reference in respect of the self- same notification, by which the land of the Petitioners was acquired is pending in a reference before the LAR&R Authority, Sambalpur.
4. Put up this matter on 8th May, 2026.
